title: Build an attaining ladder and price RMS thermal pulse precision
statement: For N>=2 fixed positive reciprocal thermal-tree lumps, source-only initial energy and R=C_total/C_source>1, CV²>=1/[1+(N-1)tanh(log(R)/(2(N-1)))], sharply attained by positive ladders. Arbitrarily many lumps still require R>=exp(2(epsilon^-2-1)) for CV<=epsilon.

requires: Linear fixed reciprocal tree, one initially excited source, fixed-temperature bath and positive capacities/conductances for the first theorem. The second requires one constant-capacity reservoir, local memoryless G(T), finite contrast, no subsequent input and all leakage counted.
provides: For N>=2 fixed positive reciprocal thermal-tree lumps, source-only initial energy and R=C_total/C_source>1, CV²>=1/[1+(N-1)tanh(log(R)/(2(N-1)))], sharply attained by positive ladders. Arbitrarily many lumps still require R>=exp(2(epsilon^-2-1)) for CV<=epsilon.
assumptions: Tree theorem does not cover loops, narrow-window concentration, nonlinear/scheduled switches or multiple excited nodes. RMS waveform width differs from timing jitter. Thermal ladder optimization maps to established OU optimal design. The continuum realization requires actual geometric regime: fixed capacity/material/delay do not independently make the slenderness parameter small. Physical switch examples do not supply the ideal local G(T); two-temperature closure/ON regimes cannot be blended. QP trajectory did not reproduce identically, although saved feasible objectives were checked. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.
costs: Tree precision charges capacity ratio; timescale scaling is not precision. Switch CV scales K^-1/3 but needs actual conductance contrast, transition width, hysteresis/storage and threshold calibration. Fixed C,g_min,g_max do not allow independent mean-delay choice. The specified constant-power loading protocol needs P>g_max*theta and costs charging/reset.
contract.units: C is heat capacity; G conductance; R,K,CV dimensionless; tau/mean are time. Deterministic bath-flux RMS width is not experimental jitter.
contract.obstruction: Acquire the whole compatible reservoir–switch–bath response, geometry, loading/reset and matched ordinary comparator before using the ideal frontier as a physical timing claim.

body: Set S_k=C_source*q^(k-1), q=R^(1/(N-1)), rho=1/q. The ladder delay kernel is exp(-|log S_k-log S_l|). Its inverse gives Z=1+(N-1)(1-rho)/(1+rho), positive endpoint weights1/(1+rho) and interior weights(1-rho)/(1+rho). Set a_k=tau*w_k/Z and resistance r_k=a_k/S_k. This attains CV²=1/Z. Collapsing off-path tree branches preserves mean and subtracts a nonnegative second-moment term, proving the tree-wide bound. OU covariance optimal design is a prior optimization antecedent. Loops and probability concentration remain outside the theorem.
